rawFindings.title: Incorrect handling of 'this$' properties in v1 Decoder readObject
rawFindings.explanation: In v1 Decoder's readObject function, the patch changes the property assignment logic of the decoded object properties. The original code filtered out keys matching /^this\$\d+$/, skipping their assignment to the object. The patch removes that check and always assigns all keys. This changes the behavior to include 'this$' properties that were previously skipped, aligning better with handling circular references and internal Java synthetic fields.
rawFindings.suggestion: Restore the original behavior, adding a condition to skip keys matching /^this\$\d+$/ to avoid exposing internal fields, or ensure that downstream code correctly handles such properties if they must be included.

rawFindings.title: Incorrect handling of 'this$' properties in v2 Decoder readObject
rawFindings.explanation: In v2 Decoder's readObject function, similar to v1, the patch removes the check that skipped assignment of properties matching /^this\$\d+$/ to the object's property dictionary. This change includes such properties in the decoded object, which could lead to unexpected exposure of internal or circular reference fields and might cause issues in decoding or usage.
rawFindings.suggestion: Restore the original conditional check to skip assignment of 'this$' fields, or ensure that such properties are intentionally included and safely handled in the rest of the codebase.

rawFindings.title: Incorrect circular reference handling in v1 Decoder.readObject
rawFindings.explanation: In lib/v1/decoder.js, the patch changed the object property reading loop in readObject such that the circular reference check to exclude keys matching /^this\$\d+$/ was removed. This causes 'this$0' style references, which are intended to represent circular references to the containing object, to be read literally as a property rather than properly referencing the parent object. This breaks correct deserialization of circular object graphs which rely on this convention.
rawFindings.suggestion: Restore the check to skip properties matching /^this\$\d+$/ during object property reading in readObject, to correctly handle circular references as intended.

rawFindings.title: Incorrect circular reference handling in v2 Decoder.readObject
rawFindings.explanation: Similar to v1, in lib/v2/decoder.js the patch removed the check that excludes keys matching /^this\$\d+$/ from being assigned as a property in readObject. This breaks the handling of 'this$0' style references in v2 Hessian deserialization, disrupting proper circular reference decoding.
rawFindings.suggestion: Restore the condition to skip keys matching /^this\$\d+$/ during property assignment in readObject to properly support circular references.

rawFindings.title: Incorrect handling of properties named 'this$<digits>' in v1 object deserialization
rawFindings.explanation: In lib/v1/decoder.js at added line 418, the loop reading properties from the byte buffer during object deserialization was modified to always assign the property to the result, removing the prior check that excluded keys matching /^this\$\d+$/ from being set. The prior behavior skipped setting these special properties likely to avoid cycles or redundant references, but the modification causes these properties to be included unconditionally, which might cause issues if some logic expects these pr
rawFindings.suggestion: Reinstate the conditional check that skips property assignment if the key matches /^this\$\d+$/, i.e., add a conditional around 'result.$[key] = this.read(withType);' to skip keys matching the regex.

rawFindings.title: Incorrect handling of properties named 'this$<digits>' in v2 object deserialization
rawFindings.explanation: In lib/v2/decoder.js at added line 588, the code for reading fields of an object during deserialization was changed to assign all properties unconditionally into the result object, removing a prior conditional that skipped fields with names matching /^this\$\d+$/. This unconditional assignment potentially breaks object invariants or reference cycles handled by skipping such fields.
rawFindings.suggestion: Restore the original conditional that excludes fields whose names match /^this\$\d+$/, assigning only properties with names that do not match the regex.
